title: Yuu Moon Bloom
description: Night-based crop growth accelerator around players.
body:
# Yuu Moon Bloom

Night-based crop growth accelerator around players.

## Features
- At night, random crops in loaded chunks can grow faster.
- Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, berries, cocoa and more.
- Configurable chunk radius, samples and growth chance.
- Built for survival servers that want dynamic nighttime farming.

## Command
- `/moonbloom [status|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuumoonbloom.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
